title: Shared kiln schedule
brief:
You coordinate a ceramics cooperative. Write an email to the three members booked for Thursday evening’s glaze firing. A visiting class needs the kiln until 7 p.m., an hour past their original start. Members can keep Thursday at 7:15 p.m. or move to Saturday at 10 a.m. Each person can choose independently. Ask for replies by Wednesday noon so you can update the studio calendar. Acknowledge the inconvenience in the warm, practical tone members expect from you.

Aim for 70 to 150 words. Return the complete original work directly in your answer. Do not sign or identify yourself. Do not use tools.

7e4ed53885c91e58.text:
Subject: Thursday evening’s glaze firing

Hi everyone,

The visiting class needs the kiln until 7 p.m. on Thursday, an hour past your original 6 p.m. start. I’m sorry for the inconvenience, especially if you’ve already planned your evening around the firing.

You can keep your Thursday booking with a new start time of 7:15 p.m. or move to Saturday at 10 a.m. Each of you can choose whichever time works best for you.

Please reply by noon on Wednesday with your preferred time so I can update the studio calendar. Thanks for being flexible.

89cb6e1f90e86de7.text:
**Subject: Thursday glaze firing time change**

Hi all,

The visiting class needs the kiln until 7 p.m. on Thursday, an hour past your scheduled start. I know a later start can complicate your evening, and I appreciate your flexibility.

You can keep your Thursday booking and start at 7:15 p.m., or move to Saturday at 10 a.m. Each of you can choose whichever time works best for you.

Please reply by noon on Wednesday with your preference so I can update the studio calendar. Thanks for making room for the class.
